name: Panicled Knapweed
desc: Panicled Knapweed (Centaurea stoebe): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Centaurea stoebe, the spotted knapweed or panicled knapweed, is a species of Centaurea native to eastern Europe, although it has spread to North America, where it is considered an invasive species.
